edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the source account for the balances lookup in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the owner key when writing the allowed mapping in approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender key for the allowance check in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the owner key and forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, a caller-controlled ownership check.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferAnyERC20Token to the stored owner address.
The Owned constructor assigns the deployer address msg.sender to owner.
Owned constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
transfer routes the balance decrement through safeSub to prevent underflow.
safeSub result is written back into the balances mapping for the sender.
transfer routes the balance increment through safeAdd to prevent overflow.
safeAdd result is written into the recipient balance entry.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom writes updated balances for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry via safeSub.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to increase the recipient balance.
approve writes the requested amount into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall invokes an attacker-controlled contract via receiveApproval after state updates.
Control returns from the external receiveApproval call into approveAndCall.
The external callback can re-enter transfer while approveAndCall is still executing.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
Control returns from the external ERC20 transfer call into transferAnyERC20Token.
YMUSIC constructor mints the whole supply into the deployer-designated balance entry.
YMUSIC constructor assigns the fixed _totalSupply value.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply without a safeSub guard, allowing underflow.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the given tokenOwner.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for the tokenOwner and spender pair.
Recipient address parameter flows into the transfer balance update.
Amount parameter flows into safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer.
Spender parameter flows into the allowed mapping key in approve.
Amount parameter is stored as the allowance value in approve.
Source account parameter flows into the balances and allowed lookups in transferFrom.
Destination account parameter flows into the recipient balance update in transferFrom.
Amount parameter flows into safeSub/safeAdd inside transferFrom.
Spender address becomes the target of the external receiveApproval callback in approveAndCall.
Amount parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
Opaque data bytes are forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary token address selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
Amount parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer call.
New owner parameter is validated and stored by the onlyOwner transferOwnership function.
Account parameter is the lookup key of the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Owner parameter is the first key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
Spender parameter is the second key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
Local result c receives the unchecked a + b computation inside safeAdd.
safeAdd returns the local variable c after the overflow require check.
Local result c receives the a - b computation inside safeSub.
safeSub returns the local variable c after the underflow require check.
Local result c receives the a * b computation inside safeMul.
safeMul returns the local variable c after the overflow require check.
Local result c receives the a / b computation inside safeDiv.
safeDiv returns the local variable c after the divide-by-zero require check.

The _newOwner parameter is only consumed by the transferOwnership function.
The tokenOwner parameter is only a lookup key inside balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter is only a lookup key inside allowance.
